### Jesus Our Peace
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-our-peace
Passage: Ephesians 2:14
Points:
- Sin alienated humanity from God and caused hostility among human beings.
- Rather than being a light to the nations, many used God's law as a wall of superiority.
- Christ fulfilled the law and tore down the dividing wall of hostility in His flesh.
- God's people are no longer identified by the Mosaic boundary, but by union with Jesus.
- Christians must never misuse God's law to isolate themselves from sharing grace with the lost.

### All Walls Finally Fall
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-may-13-2013.html
Passage: Ephesians 2:14
Points:
- Every wall built by world empires has eventually fallen.
- Invisible walls like stubborn wills and bitter spirits also seem formidable.
- Christ has destroyed the barrier and the dividing wall of hostility.
- No wall built by or against us is greater than the conquering power of Christ.
